title: Cave African Rock Plain Stone Small 13
description:
The ‘Cave African’ themed assets capture the layered, mineral-rich character of cave systems. Featuring high-fidelity scans of vertical stone columns, eroded and muddy rock formations, decorative wall sections, and muddy cave floors, this collection reflects the slow mineral deposition and erosion that shape subterranean environments over time.
Ideal for creating atmospheric cave environments with a strong sense of scale, geological detail, and environmental storytelling.
Texel density: 7313 px/m
Physical size: 0.49m x 1.13m x 0.22m
Mesh type: Open mesh
